"Gold Feather Helmet
A fashionable helmet that shines in gorgeous gold.
Everyone is fascinated by the nobility."

Skill boosts:

Metal Trading +2
Art +1
Alchemy +1

This was an event reward in the Japanese servers. Unless we happen to get this event on Maris, the helmet in question will probably be put in cove/captain's ticket or just go unreleased.

Source/pic: www.gamecity.ne.jp/dol/topics_cms/event/16890.html
